### Before to start

### eRah package workflow

How to star.

```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# eRah package installation
#install.packages('erah')
# eRah library call
library(erah)

```

Folder files

```{r echo=TRUE}

# Delete all file that are not in folders
unlink('Data/eRah_polar_column/*')
# Data folder path
createdt('Data/eRah_polar_column/')

```

New experiment.


```{r echo=TRUE}

# Loading (*.CDF) chromatograms
instrumental <- read.csv('Data/eRah_metadata_polar_column/GCMS_inst_data_CDF.csv', sep = ";")
# Loading metadata of the chromatograms (phenotype file)
phenotype <- read.csv('Data/eRah_metadata_polar_column/GCMS_pheno_data.csv', sep = ";")
# Merge of metadata information with chromatograms
ex <- newExp(instrumental = instrumental,
             phenotype = phenotype,
             info = 'B. grandiflora metabolomics')

```

Compound deconvolution

Parameter

```{r echo=TRUE}

# Deconvolution parameters for chromatogram analysis between 3.01 and 21.10 min
dec.par.3to21 <- setDecPar(min.peak.width = 3,
                           min.peak.height = 500,
                           noise.threshold = 50,
                           avoid.processing.mz = c(30:32),
                           analysis.time = c(3.01, 21.10))
# Deconvolution parameters for chromatogram analysis between 21.10 and 37.5 min
dec.par.21to37 <- setDecPar(min.peak.width = 3,
                           min.peak.height = 600,
                           noise.threshold = 60,
                           avoid.processing.mz = c(30:32),
                           analysis.time = c(21.10, 37))
# Deconvolution parameters for chromatogram analysis between 37.5 and 44.0 min
dec.par.37to44 <- setDecPar(min.peak.width = 3,
                           min.peak.height = 1000,
                           noise.threshold = 100,
                           avoid.processing.mz = c(30:32),
                           analysis.time = c(37.5, 44.0))

```

parallel processing

```{r echo=TRUE}

plan(future::multisession,
     workers = 5)

```

Deconvolution

```{r echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# Chromatogram deconvolution between 3.01 and 21.10 min
ex.3to21 <- deconvolveComp(ex,
                           dec.par.3to21)
# Chromatogram deconvolution between 21.0 and 37.5 min
ex.21to37 <- deconvolveComp(ex,
                            dec.par.21to37)
# Chromatogram deconvolution between 37.5 and 44.0 min
ex.37to44 <- deconvolveComp(ex,
                            dec.par.37to44)

```

Alignment

```{r echo=TRUE}

# Alignment parameters
ex.al.par <- setAlPar(min.spectra.cor = 0.85,
                      max.time.dist = 3,
                      mz.range = 50:500)
# Alignment of 3.01-21.10 min dataset
ex.3to21 <- alignComp(ex.3to21,
                      alParameters = ex.al.par)
# Alignment of 21.0-37.5 min dataset
ex.21to37 <- alignComp(ex.21to37,
                       alParameters = ex.al.par)
# Alignment of 37.5-44.0 set
ex.37to44 <- alignComp(ex.37to44,
                       alParameters = ex.al.par)

```

Missing compound recovery


```{r echo=TRUE}

# Missing compound recovery for 3.01-21.10 min dataset
ex.3to21 <- recMissComp(ex.3to21,
                        min.samples = 2)
# Missing compound recovery for 21.0-37.5 min dataset
ex.21to37 <- recMissComp(ex.21to37,
                         min.samples = 2)
# Missing compound recovery for 37.5-44.0 min dataset
ex.37to44 <- recMissComp(ex.37to44,
                         min.samples = 2)

```

Exporting alignment feature list.

```{r echo=TRUE}

# Extracting alignment feature list 3.01-21.0 min
feat_list.3to21 <- alignList(ex.3to21,
                             by.area = FALSE)
# Exporting alignment feature list
write.csv(feat_list.3to21,
          file = "Result/eRah_3to21min_Polar_Column/B_gradiflora_eRah_Feat_list_3to21min_Polar_Column.csv")
# Extracting alignment feature list 21.0-37.5 min
feat_list.21to37 <- alignList(ex.21to37,
                              by.area = FALSE)
# Exporting alignment feature list
write.csv(feat_list.21to37,
          file = "Result/eRah_21to37min_Polar_Column/B_gradiflora_eRah_Feat_list_21to37_Polar_Column.csv")
# Extracting alignment feature list 37.5-44.0 min
feat_list.37to44 <- alignList(ex.37to44,
                              by.area = FALSE)
# Exporting alignment feature list
write.csv(feat_list.37to44,
          file = "Result/eRah_37to44min_Polar_Column/B_gradiflora_eRah_Feat_list_37to44_Polar_Column.csv")

```

# Identification

Metabolite identification was by comparing all the spectra found against a reference database. The eRah default database was used to metabolite identification. Metabolite identification was improve by exporting all the spectra found (.msp) in eRah to NIST MS Search 2.4 software.

```{r echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# Identification of 3.01-21.10 min dataset
peak_iden.3to21 <- identifyComp(ex.3to21,
                          id.database = mslib,
                          mz.range = NULL,
                          n.putative = 1)
# Identification of 21.0-37.5 min dataset
peak_iden.21to37 <- identifyComp(ex.21to37,
                          id.database = mslib,
                          mz.range = NULL,
                          n.putative = 1)
# Identification of 37.5-44.0 min dataset
peak_iden.37to44 <- identifyComp(ex.37to44,
                          id.database = mslib,
                          mz.range = NULL,
                          n.putative = 1)

```

Exporting spectra to NIST MS Search software identification with NIST-20 library.

```{r echo=TRUE}

# 3.01-21.0 min dataset
export2MSP(peak_iden.3to21,
           store.path = "Result/eRah_3to21min_Polar_Column",
           alg.version = 2)
# 21.0-37.5 min dataset
export2MSP(peak_iden.21to37,
           store.path = "Result/eRah_21to37min_Polar_Column",
           alg.version = 2)
# 37.5-44.0 min dataset
export2MSP(peak_iden.37to44,
           store.path = "Result/eRah_37to44min_Polar_Column",
           alg.version = 2)

```
